recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore ShareableActivityDefinition to core unless a future work-group decision explicitly brings the CRMI-maintained profiles back into the base specification; future constraint changes belong in the CRMI IG.
issue_request: FHIR-18229 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested a core ShareableActivityDefinition profile requiring url, version, name, title, experimental, description, date, and publisher metadata.
initial_application: The issue was applied by commit 4a041981ba, which added the ActivityDefinition shareable spreadsheet source. R4/R5 historical artifacts and the pre-FHIR-48393 source contain StructureDefinition/shareableactivitydefinition with the requested metadata constraints.
additional_context: FHIR-48393 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 to remove ShareableActivityDefinition and related CDS profiles from base FHIR because they had moved to CRMI. FHIR-32623 was later resolved No Change on the same grounds. Current core source points users of Shareable, Publishable, Computable, and Executable profiles to CRMI, and the current CRMI package defines an active CRMI Shareable ActivityDefinition profile.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Recreating the old core profile would conflict with later approved source history and current build scope; ActivityDefinition remains active, but the old profile files and ActivityDefinition profile pack entries are intentionally absent.

related_jiras.note: Applied R6 decision and implementation commit removed ShareableActivityDefinition and related profiles from base FHIR after they moved to CRMI.
